question: The Chief Minister of a State acts as __________ of the concerned zonal council on rotation basis along with the other Chief Ministers in that zonal council.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Vice Chairman__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chief Minister of a state acts as the Vice-Chairman **of the Zonal Council for their state on a rotating basis.
 
• This role is **held for a period of one year. **
 
• The **Union Home Minister** is the Chairman of each Zonal Council. 
 
• The Chief Ministers of the states in **each zone act as Vice-Chairmen by rotation. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Zonal Councils

__
 
• They are the Statutory (and not the Constitutional) Bodies.
 
• Established by the States Reorganisation Act of 1956__.
 
• The act divided the country into five zones (Northern, Central, Eastern, Western, and Southern) and provided a zonal council for each zone.
 
• Each zonal council consists of the following members:
 
 
• the Home Minister of the Central government.
 
• Chief Ministers of all the States in the zone.
 
• Two other ministers from each state in the zone.
 
• The Administrator of each union territory in the zone.
